answer: Opening a challenge burns a deposit of 76 units that is returned only on a graded submission, so abandoning an attempt is a real loss. Because the wander deposit is held in the atlas escrow, the onyx audit records each forfeiture and the cost of a failed attempt is fixed rather than optional. A farm that opens challenges speculatively across many aliases hence burns capital on every one it does not finish. A farm of 86 pays that 184 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
